# ledger: each kind that needs a fit against each host: its demand (slots, macOS guests, memory GiB, disk GiB) and the fit.
# Attempt 1's VM is cloned and stopped (macOS); a clone targets attempt 2's new VM unless the target is already there.
pull_image x roomy -> demand (0, 0, 0, 50) fits
pull_image x no_slot -> demand (0, 0, 0, 50) fits
pull_image x slots_taken_by_foreign_vms -> demand (0, 0, 0, 50) fits
pull_image x macos_guests_taken_by_foreign_vms -> demand (0, 0, 0, 50) fits
pull_image x hypervisor_limit -> demand (0, 0, 0, 50) fits
pull_image x no_memory -> demand (0, 0, 0, 50) fits
pull_image x memory_pressure -> demand (0, 0, 0, 50) fits
pull_image x no_disk -> demand (0, 0, 0, 50) short of disk
pull_image x disk_low_water -> demand (0, 0, 0, 50) short of disk
pull_image x all_reserved -> demand (0, 0, 0, 50) short of disk
pull_image x target_already_there -> demand (0, 0, 0, 0) fits
materialise_image x roomy -> demand (0, 0, 0, 60) fits
materialise_image x no_slot -> demand (0, 0, 0, 60) fits
materialise_image x slots_taken_by_foreign_vms -> demand (0, 0, 0, 60) fits
materialise_image x macos_guests_taken_by_foreign_vms -> demand (0, 0, 0, 60) fits
materialise_image x hypervisor_limit -> demand (0, 0, 0, 60) fits
materialise_image x no_memory -> demand (0, 0, 0, 60) fits
materialise_image x memory_pressure -> demand (0, 0, 0, 60) fits
materialise_image x no_disk -> demand (0, 0, 0, 60) short of disk
materialise_image x disk_low_water -> demand (0, 0, 0, 60) short of disk
materialise_image x all_reserved -> demand (0, 0, 0, 60) short of disk
materialise_image x target_already_there -> demand (0, 0, 0, 0) fits
clone_vm x roomy -> demand (1, 0, 0, 80) fits
clone_vm x no_slot -> demand (1, 0, 0, 80) short of vm_slots
clone_vm x slots_taken_by_foreign_vms -> demand (1, 0, 0, 80) short of vm_slots
clone_vm x macos_guests_taken_by_foreign_vms -> demand (1, 0, 0, 80) fits
clone_vm x hypervisor_limit -> demand (1, 0, 0, 80) fits
clone_vm x no_memory -> demand (1, 0, 0, 80) fits
clone_vm x memory_pressure -> demand (1, 0, 0, 80) fits
clone_vm x no_disk -> demand (1, 0, 0, 80) short of disk
clone_vm x disk_low_water -> demand (1, 0, 0, 80) short of disk
clone_vm x all_reserved -> demand (1, 0, 0, 80) short of vm_slots
clone_vm x target_already_there -> demand (0, 0, 0, 0) fits
start_vm x roomy -> demand (0, 1, 8, 80) fits
start_vm x no_slot -> demand (0, 1, 8, 80) fits
start_vm x slots_taken_by_foreign_vms -> demand (0, 1, 8, 80) fits
start_vm x macos_guests_taken_by_foreign_vms -> demand (0, 1, 8, 80) short of macos_guests
start_vm x hypervisor_limit -> demand (0, 1, 8, 80) short of macos_guests
start_vm x no_memory -> demand (0, 1, 8, 80) short of memory
start_vm x memory_pressure -> demand (0, 1, 8, 80) short of memory
start_vm x no_disk -> demand (0, 1, 8, 80) short of disk
start_vm x disk_low_water -> demand (0, 1, 8, 80) short of disk
start_vm x all_reserved -> demand (0, 1, 8, 80) short of macos_guests
start_vm x target_already_there -> demand (0, 0, 0, 0) fits
